thresholdExceeded: Post-monsoon soil moisture fell below 18% with surface rock temp >36.5°C
recommendedAction: Establish micro-refugium mist corridors, restrict summit vehicular exhaust in Sinhagad, and conserve natural seepage ravines.
adminNotes: Field rangers to verify dampness around Tanaji Kada ravines before weekend tourist influx.

thresholdExceeded: Urban Heat Island ambient forecast exceeds 41.5°C for 72 consecutive hours
recommendedAction: Deploy municipal tree canopy misting nozzles around SPPU and Empress Garden roost boughs; set up ground rescue nets for fallen pups.
issuingAgency: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC Garden Dept) & Forest Dept
adminNotes: Water tanker coordination team alerted. Misting equipment inspected at SPPU Botany zone.

thresholdExceeded: Water hyacinth coverage exceeded 65% of shallow northern foraging mudflats
recommendedAction: Initiate targeted mechanical harvest of Eichhornia crassipes before migratory flyway arrivals in early November; ban construction debris dumping.
issuingAgency: State Wetland Authority & PMC Environment Cell
adminNotes: Harvester machinery tender approval awaiting commissioner sign-off.

thresholdExceeded: Dissolved Oxygen crashed below 2.1 mg/L in Bund Garden weir backwaters with water temp at 29.8°C
recommendedAction: Coordinate urgent pulse release of 150 cusecs fresh water from Khadakwasla dam; inspect industrial discharge outfalls along Mundhwa stretch.
issuingAgency: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) & Irrigation Dept
adminNotes: Pulse release executed on Sept 7th. Dissolved oxygen temporarily restored to 4.4 mg/L.

thresholdExceeded: Canopy canopy gap on Bhorgiri road widened past 28 meters due to road widening slope clearance
recommendedAction: Install two high-tension artificial arboreal rope bridges across cleared road gap to prevent ground crossing roadkills.
adminNotes: Canopy bridge schematics approved. Installation scheduled with local village eco-development committee.

thresholdExceeded: Alien Gliricidia and Lantana canopy shading reduced sunlight on laterite plateau to under 40%
recommendedAction: Organize citizen-assisted native shrub weeding on top plateau; erect protection bollards against off-road vehicle wheel ruts.
adminNotes: Volunteer drive planned with local Tekdi conservation groups for coming Saturday.

category: Dry Season Water Stress & Fringe Shift
thresholdExceeded: 4 natural rock springs in Donje valley recorded dry 3 weeks earlier than historical baseline
recommendedAction: Refill automated solar-pumped waterholes in Compartment 412; conduct camera-trap survey on village perimeter.
adminNotes: Waterholes replenished by forest bowser on Sept 10. Leopard pugmarks confirmed drinking at trough 2.

thresholdExceeded: Stream baseflow in Tamhini-Mulshi gorge dropped 40% below normal seasonal thresholds
recommendedAction: Declare 200m riparian buffer zone along perennial cloud-valley nullahs as non-intervention micro-reserve; penalize upstream farm diversions.
issuingAgency: Western Ghats Ecological Expert Monitoring Cell
adminNotes: Notice served to 3 private resorts diverting mountain streams for swimming pools.

thresholdExceeded: Secchi depth water visibility fell below 0.35m due to upstream construction siltation
recommendedAction: Install temporary sediment check curtains at Ramnadi inlet weir; anchor 6 submerged deadwood perches in central open water.
adminNotes: Awaiting deployment of bamboo and wire-mesh silt screens.

thresholdExceeded: Unshaded soil temps on ARAI slope measured 34.2°C at 10cm depth, causing 100% female embryonic shift
recommendedAction: Plant low-growing native scrub clusters (Carissa carandas, Ziziphus) to provide micro-shading on southwest-facing nesting slopes.
adminNotes: Field team to tag identified nesting burrows for non-invasive temperature logger insertion.
